## Merge and conflict resolution

The repository and official target share the reviewed `vendor-0.1.168`
ancestor, so the upgrade uses a normal two-parent merge. Six textual conflicts
required semantic resolution:

- `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml` retains the Custom required-CI and
  release-state-machine boundaries while accepting the official runtime
  resource coverage.
- `.goreleaser.yaml` remains the Custom archive-only producer configuration.
  The official `backend/resources` behavior is carried by
  `.goreleaser.simple.yaml`, `Dockerfile.goreleaser`, `deploy/Dockerfile`, and
  the Custom release image context instead of restoring official DockerHub and
  direct GoReleaser publishing.
- `Dockerfile.goreleaser` preserves `/app/image/sub2api` and
  `/app/runtime/sub2api` separation and adds `/app/resources`.
- `deploy/tests/docker-compose-security-test.sh` remains compatible with the
  Custom published Compose path and verifies the official privilege-hardening
  behavior.
- `deploy/tests/docker-runtime-resources-test.sh` verifies pricing fallback
  resources across all Custom build and release paths.
- `frontend/src/views/user/__tests__/PaymentView.spec.ts` retains Custom
  channel/recharge coverage and adds the official subscription-card grid
  assertions.

No unresolved index entries or conflict markers remain.

## Final official-path reconciliation

Of the 72 official changed paths, 59 are byte-identical to official
`v0.1.169`. Thirteen retain intentional Custom differences: the release/CI
paths above, the two Custom Compose variants, the runtime-resource test, and
seven mapped frontend i18n/settings/payment thin bridges. Twelve of those
paths changed from the previous Custom base to carry the official behavior;
`.goreleaser.yaml` intentionally remains unchanged because the equivalent
official resource-copy behavior is implemented in the Custom-owned producer
and image paths.

The official release and the final merge do not directly modify
`backend/internal/custom/**` or `frontend/src/custom/**`.
